title.narrative: Strengthening Infrastructure Management in Education for Indigenous Peoples in Brazil

description.narrative: The project "Strengthening Infrastructure Management in Education for Indigenous Peoples in Brazil" aims to strengthen the capacity of the National Fund for the Development of Education (FNDE) to manage school infrastructure, particularly for indigenous and quilombola communities. It focuses on improving the management of the Plano de Ações Articuladas (PAR), providing technical assistance to federated entities, and completing the construction of up to 120 schools for these communities. The project involves diagnostics, project revisions, construction work, and continuous evaluation. The schools are located in the Centro-Oeste, Norte, and Nordeste regions of Brazil.
